description: This file defines types and a store interface for managing conversation references in MS Teams proactive messaging. It includes type definitions for conversation references, store entries, and the store interface with methods for CRUD operations and user targeting.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Method to insert or update a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Method to retrieve a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to list all conversation store entries.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Method to remove a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Method to find the most recent personal DM conversation reference for a user, used for proactive messaging.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Deprecated method, replaced by `findPreferredDmByUserId`, for finding user conversation references.
